name: table_io
description: Imports a table from a CSV, a TSV or an xlsx as typed columns, in WebAssembly

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm test && cp ../../LICENSE ../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md .
scripts.build: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" cargo build -p table_io_js --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --remove-name-section --out-dir wasm --out-name table_io ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/table_io_js.wasm
